questions.question: Kawakatsu（2025）的 BDD 葡萄糖电氧化中，摘要报告的较优稀有糖生成电位及其参比标尺是什么？

evidence.quote:
The applied potential significantly influenced the product distribution, with optimal rare sugar production observed
at 2.5 V vs Ag/AgCl, reflecting a balance between glucose oxidation and product degradation.

answer_points.text: 报告较优稀有糖生成电位为 2.5 V vs Ag/AgCl。
该判断是平衡葡萄糖氧化与产物降解，不等于最高电位必然最好。

must_not_claim: 不能将 Ag/AgCl 改为 RHE，或混用 10 mA 恒电流条件。

questions.question: How does Beeler (2025) initiate aryl-halide reduction through oxidation, and what is the reducing intermediate?

evidence.quote:
Specifically, electrochemical
oxidation of an outer-sphere redox mediator, 1,1-dimethylferrocene,
in dry N,N-dimethylformamide (DMF) containing oxalate (C2O4
2−),
results in the homogeneous one-electron oxidation of C2O4
2−. The
resulting C2O4
•−decomposes in ∼1 μs to release the carbon dioxide radical anion (CO2
•−), a potent reductant that is oxidized to
CO2 at −2.68 V vs Fc/Fc+.

answer_points.text: 在干 DMF 中氧化 1,1-二甲基二茂铁介体，引发草酸根的一电子氧化。
生成草酸根自由基随后分解为 CO2 自由基阴离子，后者是强还原剂。

must_not_claim: 不属于阴极直接 CO2 电还原；不要把 CO2 自由基阴离子写成中性 CO2。

questions.question: Sheng（2025）的苄位 C-H 硫酸酯化与传统 O-磺酰化相比，对原料羟基的要求有何区别？

evidence.quote:
Current methods for producing
organosulfates primarily rely on O-sulfonation, which
limits their applicability to hydroxyl-containing com-
pounds. Herein, we report a practical and cost-efﬁcient
method for the electrochemical sulfation of benzylic
C─H bonds.

answer_points.text: 传统 O-磺酰化限制于含羟基化合物。
本文直接苄位 C-H 硫酸酯化，不能把它改述为仅修饰预先存在的羟基。

must_not_claim: 不得把 C-H 官能化与 O-磺酰化的反应位点混同。

questions.question: In Kim (2025), how do halohydrins connect electrochemical CO2 capture to cyclic-carbonate formation, and what coproduct is generated?

evidence.quote:
This method involves the
electrochemical deprotonation of halohydrin molecules, which generate
hydrogen and halo-alkoxides that capture CO2 and spontaneously undergo
intramolecular cyclization to yield cyclic carbonates.

answer_points.text: 电化学去质子化卤代醇生成氢气和卤代烷氧负离子。
后者捕获 CO2 并自发分子内环化为环状碳酸酯。

must_not_claim: 不得将 CO2 捕集/环化写成传统 CO2 电还原到甲酸或 CO。

questions.question: Chen（2025）在 GDY/NiPd/GDY 界面报告了哪两种原子结构变化？这些证据来自什么表征？

evidence.quote:
The results of atomic-resolution electron microscopy characterization revealed two unique interfacial phenomena: i)
GDY-induced massive dislocation formation within NiPd nanoalloys and ii) rearrangement of surface metal atoms
from (111) to (200) facets.

answer_points.text: 原子分辨电子显微表征显示 GDY 诱导 NiPd 纳米合金中大量位错。
报告表面金属原子由 (111) 到 (200) 晶面的重排。

must_not_claim: 不得把观测描述替代为计算直接证明全部动态路径。

questions.question: For Shi (2025) Au-catalyzed ethylene-glycol/methanol cross-coupling to lactic acid, report the current density, productivity and FE.

evidence.quote:
achieving a
high LA productivity of 268.1 μmol cm−2 h−1 with a Faradaic efficiency of 28.7% at a constant current of 100 mA cm−2.

answer_points.text: 100 mA cm−2 下 LA 面产率 268.1 μmol cm−2 h−1。
LA FE 为 28.7%；不是收率或 PET 瓶实验的累计面产量。

must_not_claim: 不能把 224.5 μmol cm−2 的两小时累计产量写成同工况的每小时面产率。
